title: Integrate guided character creation into CLI new-campaign flow
description: Review finding from loreweaver-1ek. Character creation exists in core but loreweaver play can create a new campaign and enter turns without guided creation or validation. Parent context: loreweaver-d4r.
acceptance_criteria: A new CLI campaign cannot proceed to normal turns without an accepted canonical character or an explicit documented deferral path; tests cover valid and invalid character drafts through the CLI flow.
close_reason: CLI play now requires accepted canonical character creation or explicit /defer before normal turns; verification: npm run typecheck and npm run test passed.
